text: Heres what i want you to do, the current @cart/hmsc-int/editors/model/Studio.tsx file is getting massive. and there is still a number of things we are looking to get packed into here that, quite frankly, the file structure is just starting to get a bit rough. so, ideally what id like to be done is that you dont change anything about it, and propose a side-by-side replacement of it that takes what the current capability is into account as a first class thought process both in ui and file structure. This does not mean that anything at all about how it works will change, so this is not an ask to make a new approach, its to better structure the application so that it doesnt become a massive pain in the ass to do any changes
